mentions.claim_text: He repeats three times that the Lord said to remember the fox with the Bay of Pigs in Cuba concerning New Orleans, and says he sees it very clear.
mentions.quote: Remember the fox in the Bay of Pigs for Cuba concerning New Orleans
mentions.falsify_match: A Cuba originated action against New Orleans.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs. The fox is still not identified.

mentions.claim_text: He says that when it happens people will call it terrorism but it will be a retaliation from Iran, and that an act of war of retaliation is different from terrorism.
mentions.quote: They will say oh it's terrorist. No, it's a retaliation
mentions.falsify_match: An attack on American soil formally attributed to Iranian direction.
mentions.falsify_miss: An attack attributed to a lone actor. He pre-frames that outcome as a mislabel, so it cannot count against him.

mentions.claim_text: He says he does not follow soccer and prefers American sports, and that he saw them rioting and burning things.
mentions.quote: I saw them rioting and burning
mentions.falsify_match: Major rioting around a football tournament.

mentions.claim_text: He says a man must be bathed in prayer because a compromise in his heart would try to happen at fifty fifty, held in the balance by the church in Colombia, and that he saw the fox again concerning the Bay of Pigs and an attack in New Orleans.
mentions.quote: it's being held in the balance by the church in Colombia
mentions.falsify_match: A Colombian leader holds against a compromise.
mentions.falsify_miss: He compromises. The fifty fifty framing means either outcome fits.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord named the enemy within, subways, mass transit and baseball, and asks prayer over law enforcement and the president, then says there is an attack against Israel again at night.
mentions.quote: the Lord said and subways mass transit and baseball
mentions.falsify_match: An attack on American mass transit or a night attack on Israel.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw it with China and that the United States can do it too, citing the fires in Hawaii and the Malibu area as arson rather than natural.
mentions.quote: We saw the fires in Malibu area. It was an arson
mentions.falsify_match: Deliberate ignition is established for those fires.
mentions.falsify_miss: Investigations attribute them to other causes.

mentions.claim_text: He prays for cooler Canadian air to come down because it is getting too hot and they do not want to scorch.
mentions.quote: you bring some cooler temperatures down from the Canadian air
mentions.falsify_match: Temperatures fall after the prayer.
mentions.falsify_miss: The heat continues. Weather always changes, so this reads as answered on any timescale.

mentions.claim_text: He cites research that over two billion dollars was funnelled to a named Georgia figure, says the Lord told him to watch Georgia and that the devil went down to Georgia, and that he saw Atlanta.
mentions.quote: Over $2 billion was funneled to Stacey Abrams
mentions.falsify_match: Findings of misused funds tied to that figure.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such findings. The figure comes from what people were saying rather than from a document.

mentions.claim_text: He says a death was inflicted by poison rather than a true stroke or heart attack but was made to look like natural causes, so responders were not treating it as poisoning.
mentions.quote: It wasn't a true stroke or a heart attack, but it looked like natural causes
mentions.falsify_match: A prominent death is later found to be poisoning.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such finding. He does not name the person.

mentions.claim_text: He says he got cranky about the Turkey trip and should not have, that if the president feels led to go they will pray for him, and mentions presenting a pig to Turkey in the days ahead.
mentions.quote: I got cranky about it and I shouldn't have
mentions.falsify_match: The Turkey visit produces the harm he warns about.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. He softens his own objection here.

mentions.claim_text: He says they are only a group of three and asks for grace, hoping God will provide a secretary one day, then refers back to something he said about a named congresswoman before it was in the news.
mentions.quote: We're only a group of three, folks
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing to match; an operational aside.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing to miss; no forward content.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw government money being funnelled back to the Democratic party as a slush fund in accounts, and that the figure was twenty four billion dollars.
mentions.quote: I saw the money. It was $24 billion
mentions.falsify_match: A federal funding diversion of that scale is documented.

mentions.claim_text: He says he had said Europe and the Eiffel Tower would be on fire and did not know how it would happen, and that it then appeared on the news with the tower burning during riots.
mentions.quote: Europe and the Eiffel Tower will be on fire
mentions.falsify_match: The Eiffel Tower catches fire.
mentions.falsify_miss: Only fires near it during unrest. He does not distinguish the tower burning from things burning around it.

mentions.claim_text: He says the scissors will cut his strings in the days ahead, that a proxy government comes into Ukraine that is pro-Russia and pro-Ukraine with Kyiv split down the middle, and that when the man is eliminated he will be snorting cocaine at a party.
mentions.quote: they're going to cut his strings in the days ahead
mentions.falsify_match: Zelensky is removed and a partitioned proxy government follows.

mentions.claim_text: He says the king came out stinging and very bold as he had said, and that this is what is about to be seen concerning Canada and Europe, with England struck.
mentions.quote: he will come out and start stinging things and come out very bold
mentions.falsify_match: The British monarch takes an unusually political and forceful public position.

mentions.claim_text: He recalls something coming out of the Mississippi River into the bay at Oakland, unloaded there and taken to Denver and to Missouri, notes it has not been seen and says he keeps praying over it.
mentions.quote: they unloaded this thing and they took it to Denver
mentions.falsify_match: A device is intercepted on that route.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing is found. He states himself that it has not happened.

mentions.claim_text: He says Cuba will be liberated, that Putin is holding his cards because he knows the president's term will end, and that when it does Putin will come out as more of a tyrant.
mentions.quote: he will come out as more of a tyrant in the days ahead
mentions.falsify_match: Russian aggression increases after January 2029.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. The window runs past the end of the term, so nothing before then can settle it.

mentions.claim_text: He says the shaking runs through Vancouver and San Francisco with the streets splitting and major buildings falling, and that thirty thousand people will pass in those areas, then turns to Okinawa.
mentions.quote: 30,000 people will pass in these areas
mentions.falsify_match: A west coast earthquake killing tens of thousands.

mentions.claim_text: He and his co-host read out a list of the day's earthquakes, a 5.0, a 4.2 in New Zealand, a 6.6 in Afghanistan and several others, noting there is a whole chart of them.
mentions.quote: 6.6 in Afghanistan. Now that's pretty big
mentions.falsify_match: An unusual global cluster of large quakes.
mentions.falsify_miss: Ordinary daily seismicity. The globe records around fifteen magnitude 4 and above events a day, which is what the chart shows.

mentions.claim_text: He asks prayer over New Orleans, Boston, Dallas Fort Worth, Chicago and New York, naming the Macy's fireworks show and the incoming mayor.
mentions.quote: praying for Chicago, New York, the Macy's fireworks show
mentions.falsify_match: An attack at a July Fourth event in one of the named cities.

mentions.claim_text: He says the shakings are symbolic and the same is about to happen to Israel, that a shaking is coming to Israel about the Mount of Olives, and that the Dome of the Rock will be affected.
mentions.quote: It'll be about the Mount of Olives. It's a symbolic shaking
mentions.falsify_match: An earthquake at the Mount of Olives affecting the Dome of the Rock.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such earthquake. He marks it symbolic, which allows a non physical reading either way.

mentions.claim_text: He asks his wife for the exact word and settles on socialist, saying he saw it go over Europe, Australia and Canada.
mentions.quote: I saw it go over Europe, Australia, Canada. Socialist
mentions.falsify_match: Socialist governments take power across those regions.

mentions.claim_text: He says it was socialism over Europe and that the Lord said work while it is day for night is coming, concerning live streaming and the internet, and that live stream will become dead in Europe.
mentions.quote: Live stream will become dead in Europe
mentions.falsify_match: Live streaming is effectively banned or made unusable in Europe.

mentions.claim_text: He says there will be huge camp meetings like the 1980s and 90s because people cannot hear freely on the internet and want to experience the glory in person, calling it a Holy Ghost Woodstock, with persecution coming for freedom of speech.
mentions.quote: Major meetings with like huge camp meetings
mentions.falsify_match: Mass in person meetings replace online ministry after speech restrictions.

mentions.claim_text: Told by the chat that Okinawa holds military bases, he says whatever it is it is very important and that the Lord said to watch Okinawa because there is something about it.
mentions.quote: Watch Okinawa. There's something about Okinawa
mentions.falsify_match: A major event at Okinawa.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing notable. The meaning is supplied by his audience rather than by the word.

mentions.claim_text: He says he laid it out as quickly as he could but cannot give more because he saw a lot of details concerning ministries which he says the Lord told him not to say out loud.
mentions.quote: I saw a lot of details concerning ministries and Lord, do not say that
mentions.falsify_match: Ministry scandals emerge matching what he says he was shown.
mentions.falsify_miss: None do. Withholding the content means nothing here can be checked either way.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw the president going to a meeting with Turkey in the days ahead that he is invited to, and began to say do not go.
mentions.quote: I saw President Trump going to a meeting with Turkey
mentions.falsify_match: A presidential visit to Turkey takes place.

mentions.claim_text: He says Turkey's plan is to be friends with Russia, that Russia and Turkey are trying to involve the president in doing something about the Ukrainian president, and that his days are numbered.
mentions.quote: the plan of Turkey was to be friends with Russia
mentions.falsify_match: A Turkey and Russia understanding on Ukraine involving American acquiescence.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw a major earthquake in Seattle, a shaking of politics and a shaking in Portland, with the Lord dealing clear down to San Francisco.
mentions.quote: I saw a major earthquake taking place in Seattle
mentions.falsify_match: A major Pacific northwest earthquake.

mentions.claim_text: He describes the earth breathing gas like a leak and burning from British Columbia all the way to Alaska, correcting himself mid-sentence, with the volcano and the earthquake alongside.
mentions.quote: almost like the earth was breathing gas and it was on fire
mentions.falsify_match: Ground fires along the British Columbia to Alaska coast after a quake.

mentions.claim_text: He turns to the news saying some of what is happening is very serious, and his co-host begins on Taiwan.
mentions.quote: this is very serious. Some of the things that are happening
mentions.falsify_match: A Taiwan crisis follows.

mentions.claim_text: Told that American strikes are ongoing and classified, he says he did not see this thing ending.
mentions.quote: I said this thing is going to go on for I didn't see it ending
mentions.falsify_match: The campaign against Iran continues without resolution.
mentions.falsify_miss: It ends in a settlement. An open ended claim cannot expire.

mentions.claim_text: He notes a 1.3 billion dollar lawsuit against a named figure and a five year, eight hundred page report of voting machine fraud evidence said to be coming out.
mentions.quote: 800 page report of evidence of fraud from Dominion Machines
mentions.falsify_match: The report is published and substantiated.
mentions.falsify_miss: It is not published or is not substantiated.

mentions.claim_text: He tells listeners to be water baptised, get into a church, read a Bible daily and pray, and to do it while the door is open because night is coming, especially in Europe.
mentions.quote: Work while it is day, for night is coming
mentions.falsify_match: Religious broadcasting is curtailed in Europe.

mentions.claim_text: He describes going across Europe in vision, seeing people and waterfalls coming out of a mountain, with the Lord saying that is the Swiss Alps.
mentions.quote: the Lord said, That's Swiss Alps
mentions.falsify_match: A revival movement in the Alpine region.

mentions.claim_text: Reading a 6.7 in Greenland and a Philippines quake, he wonders whether temples were shaken down and whether the Philippines has monkey temples, and repeats that shakings are coming.
mentions.quote: I wonder if the temple shook down there if they have temples
mentions.falsify_match: Ancient temples destroyed by earthquakes.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such destruction. He is asking whether the countries have temples rather than knowing.

mentions.claim_text: Asking the Holy Spirit for help recalling it, he says the shaking was given as a sign of revival, that God will shake places including Okinawa and shake down temples.
mentions.quote: I'm going to shake these places and I'm going to shake down temples
mentions.falsify_match: Temples brought down by earthquakes in Asia.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such collapses. He has to be prompted to recall his own word here.

mentions.claim_text: Reading a 5.7 he says get ready for Okinawa, that something will happen there, and that a very big major volcano is going to go off in Japan, noting Alaska too.
mentions.quote: a very big volcano is going to go off in Japan
mentions.falsify_match: A major Japanese eruption.
mentions.falsify_miss: No eruption beyond the ordinary Japanese pattern.

mentions.claim_text: He says God is the same yesterday, today and forever and that they will see some of the greatest miracles ever seen in the days ahead.
mentions.quote: we're going to see some of the greatest miracles that we've ever seen
mentions.falsify_match: Documented healings at unusual scale.

mentions.claim_text: He notes a major 7.5 earthquake in Venezuela that day followed by a 7.2 in the same area, and says a shaking is coming to South America.
mentions.quote: A shaking is coming to South America
mentions.falsify_match: Continued major seismicity across South America.

mentions.claim_text: Reading a 6.9 in Japan, he asks whether it was in California because the Lord said he would shake Malibu and shake California, and says he is looking for Malibu to be shaken all the time.
mentions.quote: I'm going to shake Malibu. I'm going to shake California
mentions.falsify_match: A damaging earthquake at Malibu.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such earthquake. He checks whether a Japanese quake was Californian, which shows how loosely the reports are being matched.

mentions.claim_text: He says the word said it was coming and they are seeing the beginnings, the birthing pains, and repeats that Colombia, Venezuela and Cuba will be shaken.
mentions.quote: Colombia will be shaken. Venezuela will be shaken
mentions.falsify_match: Significant earthquakes in all three.
mentions.falsify_miss: Only Venezuela, which is already on the Caribbean plate boundary and seismically active.

mentions.claim_text: He asks whether an earthquake happened near San Francisco, is told it did not and that it is further north, and says that is a bummer but it is coming.
mentions.quote: That's a bummer. It's coming
mentions.falsify_match: A San Francisco earthquake.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs. He accepts the correction rather than claiming the northern event.

mentions.claim_text: Watching footage of a building collapsing in Venezuela he calls it a major shaking and says they know major revival is coming for Venezuela.
mentions.quote: we know what's coming for Venezuela. Major revival
mentions.falsify_match: A religious movement in Venezuela after the earthquake.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Bible says these things are coming and that labour pains do not get better but worse and worse until the baby comes, and that they are seeing labour pains increase.
mentions.quote: labor pains don't get better. They get worse
mentions.falsify_match: An accelerating run of disasters.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing can fail; a worsening frame absorbs any outcome.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord said major volcanoes are about to erupt and that meteors will come in that bust out windows, calling them signs of the times.
mentions.quote: major volcanoes are about to erupt and we're going to see meteors
mentions.falsify_match: Simultaneous major eruptions and a damaging bolide event.

mentions.claim_text: He tells someone urgently to stay home and not travel anywhere right now, to wait until after the anniversary of America, with Turkey mentioned as the destination.
mentions.quote: Stay here until after the anniversary of America
mentions.falsify_match: An incident befalls the traveller or the destination in that window.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw it spread in pockets where she had influence, in Atlanta and other important cities with major voter turnouts, that it was about a Senate seat, and then he saw Minnesota.
mentions.quote: I saw influence and where she had pockets of influence in Atlanta
mentions.falsify_match: Election irregularities found in those places tied to a Senate race.

mentions.claim_text: He describes specks of silver being taken out of barrels and distributed to the Democratic party, and says Harris will try to rebrand herself with a new suit that had things on it.
mentions.quote: she will try to rebrand
mentions.falsify_match: Harris relaunches publicly with a changed image.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw an uprising, that the New York mayor is boasting about a communist party being formed there with four socialists winning their elections, and asks prayer for New York because a great shaking is coming.
mentions.quote: Four major communistic socialist evil people won their elections
mentions.falsify_match: A left bloc consolidates control of New York city politics.

mentions.claim_text: He says the five families will say it is just business and that they will not allow themselves to lose their nation, coming out as heroes so that what was once a crime family becomes what saves New York, and adds that he saw Union and New Orleans.
mentions.quote: What was once a crime family becomes somebody that saves New York
mentions.falsify_match: Organised crime is publicly credited with resisting the city administration.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such role. He says himself he does not know what it means.

mentions.claim_text: Told the Israeli prime minister will stay in the southern Lebanon security zone, he asks whether that is defying America and says he will tell what he saw in a vision.
mentions.quote: So, he's defying America or what?
mentions.falsify_match: An open Israel and America split over Lebanon.

mentions.claim_text: He plays the Israeli prime minister saying that while he is prime minister Iran will not have nuclear weapons and the security zone in southern Lebanon will be maintained, covering Gaza, Lebanon and Iran.
mentions.quote: as long as I am prime minister, we are maintaining the security zone
mentions.falsify_match: The zone is held and Iran stays non-nuclear while he serves.
mentions.falsify_miss: Either fails, or he leaves office. The condition is his own tenure, which he does not control.

mentions.claim_text: He plays a Turkish speaker saying the American president's presence in Ankara is eagerly anticipated and that he will be there in less than two weeks.
mentions.quote: your presence in Ankara is eagerly anticipated
mentions.falsify_match: The Ankara visit takes place in that window.

mentions.claim_text: He says the foreign allies are crazy and want war, that as he told them the man in Turkey will beat his drums and is a bad man aligned with Syria, and that in the days ahead they will come against Israel.
mentions.quote: the man in Turkey is a bad man. He is with Syria
mentions.falsify_match: Turkey and Syria move militarily against Israel.
